t: You're at the Eagle Squadrons Memorial in Grosvenor Square, a Second World War memorial. It remembers the three Royal Air Force Eagle Squadrons, which served from 1940 to 1942, including during the Battle of Britain. It honours in particular their 244 Americans and 16 British fighter pilots, of whom 71 were killed. On top is a bronze eagle, made by the sculptor Elisabeth Frink.
